evidence_span.text: Taken together, our observations establish that NRP1 enables CDC42 activation and CDC42-dependent actin dynamics and filopodia extension in ECM-stimulated ECs, independently of VEGF-A signaling.

reviews.rationale: NRP1 knockdown and CDC42 inhibition causally support the regulator pathway controlling endothelial filopodia. The embryonic hindbrain and other endothelial models are closely related but not identical to postnatal brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: The down-regulation of Kir2.1 reduced OSS-induced EPC mesenchymal transdifferentiation.

reviews.rationale: Kir2.1 was directly perturbed under oscillating shear stress, supporting its shear-responsive endothelial function. The EPC and vascular-injury settings are indirect to postnatal brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: Adult Pdgfbret/ret brains display ongoing angiogenic sprouting without concomitant cell proliferation providing unique insights into the endothelial tip cell transcriptome.

reviews.rationale: The study profiles angiogenic brain endothelial tip cells after pericyte loss, supporting the cited contextual claim; Angpt2 is studied for BBB reinforcement, not the assigned sprouting function. Adult pathological pericyte deficiency is only a partial match to normal postnatal development.
